Staking

Stake ACME to earn a share of protocol fees. Rewards are paid every epoch (about 2 days).

How it works​

  1. Connect your wallet.
  2. Choose an amount and click Stake.
warning

Unstaking takes 7 days.

const stake = await acme.stake(100)
console.log(stake)
